question: How do I create an account?
answer: Select Create account on the sign-in page and verify your email address using the link we send.

question: Can I change the email on my account?
answer: Open Account settings and choose Update email. We send a verification link to the new address before the change takes effect.

question: Why is my account locked?
answer: Accounts are temporarily locked after repeated unsuccessful sign-in attempts. Wait 15 minutes
source_document: then try again or contact support if the lock remains.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Choose Forgot password on the sign-in page and follow the one-time link sent to your verified email address. The link expires after 30 minutes.

question: My password reset email did not arrive. What should I do?

question: What is your refund policy?
answer: You may request a refund within 30 days of an eligible purchase. Contact support with your order ID; approved refunds are returned to the original payment method within 5 to 10 business days.

question: When will I receive my refund?
answer: After approval
source_document: refunds are sent to the original payment method and usually appear within 5 to 10 business days. Your bank may take longer to post the credit.

question: Where can I find my invoices?
answer: Open Billing in your account settings to view and download invoices for completed purchases.

question: How do I update my payment method?
answer: Go to Account settings
access_classification: and select Manage payment method. Payment details are handled by our payment processor.

question: Can I export my reports?
answer: Yes. Open a report and use Export to download it as a CSV file. Export availability depends on your account plan.

question: Does the product support team collaboration?
answer: Team workspaces let invited members collaborate on shared projects. Workspace owners manage invitations and member roles in Settings.

question: Can I change notification preferences?
answer: Open Settings
access_classification: and enable or disable each available email notification.

question: How can I track my order?
answer: When a physical order ships
source_document: we email a tracking link. You can also open Orders in your account to see the latest tracking status.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: The estimated delivery window is shown at checkout and in your shipping confirmation. Delivery timing varies by destination and carrier.

question: What if my package is delayed?
answer: Check the carrier tracking link first. If tracking has not updated for 5 business days
source_document: contact support with your order ID.

question: How do I return an eligible item?
answer: Start a return from Orders within 30 days of delivery. Follow the instructions provided after your return request is approved.

question: Can I cancel an order?
answer: You can request cancellation from Orders while the order is still being prepared. Shipped orders cannot be cancelled; use the return process after delivery.

question: Are return shipping costs covered?
answer: The return instructions show any applicable shipping charge before you confirm. The knowledge base does not specify a universal free-return policy.

question: The app is not loading. What can I try?
answer: Check your connection
access_classification: and try an up-to-date supported browser. If the issue continues
last_updated: contact support with the time and a description of the error.

question: How do I clear a sync error?
answer: Confirm your device is online
source_document: then use Settings to retry synchronization. Do not share passwords or authentication codes with support.

question: Which browsers are supported?
answer: Use a current version of Chrome
last_updated: or Safari for the best experience. Older browser versions may not receive full support.

question: How do you protect my account?
answer: We use account authentication and access controls to protect the service. Never share your password or one-time authentication codes; contact support if you suspect unauthorized access.

question: How can I request deletion of my account?
answer: Contact support from your verified account to request account deletion. We will explain any applicable retention obligations before processing the request.

question: Do you ask for my password by email?
answer: No. Support will not ask you to send your password or one-time authentication code by email or chat.
